name: Tajika Tomoe
source:
She is a first-year student at St.Trea School. A member of the puzzle club.

She is a sporty girl with a heart of a maiden. She has a gentle personality, and when she has someone she cares about, she can't leave them alone. 

She is naturally becoming curious of the opposite sex. She is a good listener and fun to be with. She has a complex about being a little tall.
